title: My Mom Tried To Help My Bullying, It Got WORSE 😭 #shorts
description:
Speaker vividly recounts his childhood struggle, being one of only five people of color and overweight in primary school, which made him a target for relentless bullying. He reveals that his mom's well-intentioned interventions at school only intensified the embarrassment, making his journey to find confidence even more challenging. ⚡
